FILRODENSWMB.UI.ShortcutEscape: Escape to close a menu or dialogue
FILRODENSWMB.UI.ImportSettingsEmpty: That file didn't contain any recognised custom biomes or styles.
FILRODENSWMB.UI.LevelWatersHint: How far this layer's regions claim the sea from their coasts, in map pixels (the scale bar in the Cartography tool can show what a pixel is in your map's units). Water goes to the nearest region, so neighbours meet halfway; a lake with one region on all its shores is wholly that region's. At 0 regions own land only. The waters follow every stroke.
FILRODENSWMB.UI.PinStyleHint: A named look for a kind of place: its icon, colour and size, and its label's size and visibility. A pin made with a style follows the style when it is edited. Pin styles are managed in Styles and icons.
FILRODENSWMB.UI.PinStyleLabelHint: What the label of a pin made with this style starts with. A label style sets its font, colour, width and alignment; the size here is used over the label style's own.
FILRODENSWMB.UI.RouteDetailEditorHint: Used by Simplify: a waypoint is dropped when it lies within this many map cells of the line between its neighbours. The same setting as Detail on the bar.
FILRODENSWMB.JOURNAL.StandardPalette: No custom biome colours applied. Standard palette active.
FILRODENSWMB.UI.HelpCreditsIntro: The module includes this code, these icons and these fonts, each under its own licence.
FILRODENSWMB.UI.FaultSpacingHint: The typical distance between volcanoes, in island sizes. Low values merge neighbouring volcanoes into larger islands.
FILRODENSWMB.UI.EngineStandardHint: Uses standard noise generation to create quick, randomised terrain.
